mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE G (DOMAIN_GRP_ID, LVL, PATH, SORT_PATH) AS ( SELECT DOMAIN_GRP_ID, 1, DOMAIN_GRP_NM::text, lpad(COALESCE(SORT_ORDER, 0)::text, 5, '0') || DOMAIN_GRP_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP WHERE PARENT_GRP_ID IS NULL AND DICT_ID = #{dictId} UNION ALL SELECT C.DOMAIN_GRP_ID, G.LVL + 1, G.PATH || ' > ' || C.DOMAIN_GRP_NM, G.SORT_PATH || '/' || lpad(COALESCE(C.SORT_ORDER, 0)::text, 5, '0') || C.DOMAIN_GRP_NM FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP C JOIN G ON C.PARENT_GRP_ID = G.DOMAIN_GRP_ID WHERE G.LVL < 10 ) select A.DOMAIN_GRP_ID as id ,A.DOMAIN_GRP_NM ,A.COMM_STND_YN ,A.PARENT_GRP_ID as parentGrpId ,P.DOMAIN_GRP_NM as parentGrpNm ,A.DFLT_DATA_TYPE as dfltDataType ,A.CLSF_WORD_NM as clsfWordNm ,COALESCE(A.SORT_ORDER, 0) as sortOrder ,G.LVL as level ,G.PATH as path ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP C WHERE C.PARENT_GRP_ID = A.DOMAIN_GRP_ID) as childCnt ,to_char(to_timestamp(A.CRET_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as cretDt ,A.CRET_USER_ID ,to_char(to_timestamp(A.UPDT_DT,'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as updtDt ,A.UPDT_USER_ID from TB_DOMAIN_GRP A join G on G.DOMAIN_GRP_ID = A.DOMAIN_GRP_ID left join TB_DOMAIN_GRP P on P.DOMAIN_GRP_ID = A.PARENT_GRP_ID order by G.SORT_PATH

SELECT G.DOMAIN_GRP_NM as "domainGrpNm", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP C WHERE C.PARENT_GRP_ID = G.DOMAIN_GRP_ID) as "childCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN_CLSF S WHERE S.DICT_ID = G.DICT_ID AND S.DOMAIN_GRP_NM = G.DOMAIN_GRP_NM) as "clsfCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DOMAIN D WHERE D.DICT_ID = G.DICT_ID AND D.DOMAIN_GRP_NM = G.DOMAIN_GRP_NM) as "domainCnt" FROM TB_DOMAIN_GRP G WHERE G.DOMAIN_GRP_ID = #{id}
